title: Wrong-key assertion is masked by the backup-format rejection
evidence: UpgradeLocal writes localUpgradeFormat. RestoreBackup forwards policy=nil. readBackupPolicy rejects m.Format != backupFormat(nil) before evaluating HMAC. A correct key would fail identically.
required_change: Read the same snapshot with an exact matching local-upgrade policy: first require correct-key read success and expected files, then change only the key and require authentication rejection. Do not count a format/purpose failure as key rejection.
